newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait poll centres close in parliament election.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait poll centres close in parliament election.

text.p: Polling stations in Kuwait closed on Monday after a 12-hour voting process to elect the tiny country's second parliament since the 1991 Gulf War.
Kuwait state television showed police officers closing the main gates of polling stations on time at eight p.m. (1700 GMT) but voters inside can still cast their ballots.
Results are expected early on Tuesday.
Candidates and political analysts said turnout soared in the final hours to exceed 75 percent in most districts.
Out of some 700,000 Kuwaitis about 107,000 males have the right to vote to select 50 new parliament members from 230 candidates.
